title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1982-08-08

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a hot 1982 Alpine Valley show with standout 'Scarlet/Fire', 'They Love Each Other' jams and tight Garcia guitar work.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as crystal‑clear, true soundboard quality that lets every nuance of the band shine.  The performance itself is described as “hot” and high‑energy, highlighted by a fiery Scarlet/Fire sequence, an inspired They Love Each Other jam, and strong renditions of Good Lovin', Promised Land and Samson.  Guest musicians (Hamza El Din on drums, John Cippolina on guitar) add extra excitement, while the mix remains balanced though a few listeners wished for more bass presence.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.3/5 across >10 detailed reviews, all emphasizing excellent sound and strong performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with very little noise; reviewers call it phenomenal and outstanding. No major drop‑outs, only occasional comment wishing for a bit more bass presence.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows seamlessly; reviewers note easy editing to make it continuous and praise the energetic pacing throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Tight, crisp guitar work; bends strings beautifully on Promised Land; overall tight playing praised.
band_member_comments.Phil: Savage/insane bass performance, described as 'Phil bombs'; one reviewer wished for a bit more bass in the mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Earnest vocal delivery on Good Lovin' and strong rhythmic contributions noted.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland appears (brief mention of his tune with limited jam), no specific praise beyond presence.
band_member_comments.Drums: Guest drummer Hamza El Din praised as a favorite drum performance; rhythm section described as 'overdrive'.
